questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(13, 390, 6)

(9, 180, 4)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (Second number ÷ First number) ÷ 5 = Third number

 
• (13, 390, 6) → (390 ÷ 13) ÷ 5 = 30 ÷ 5 = 6
 
• (9, 180, 4) → (180 ÷ 9) ÷ 5 = 20 ÷ 5 = 4

Similarly,

 
• (11, 385, 7) → (385 ÷ 11) ÷ 5 = 35 ÷ 5 = 7

Hence, '**(11, 385, 7)**' is the correct answer.

A & B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If H @ V & K % Q # F, then how is H related to F?
questions.solution:
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

to B

 
 
 

H @ V & K % Q # F → H is spouse of V, V is father of K, K is sister of Q, Q is mother of F.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png]

Hence, ‘**Maternal grandmother**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six people M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Q is the immediate neighbour of M and R. N is sitting third to the left of Q. O is the immediate neighbour of R and N. R is sitting second to the left of N. Who is sitting between M and N when considered from the right of N?
questions.solution:
Six people **M, N, O, P, Q and R** are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1. N is sitting third to the left of Q.

2. R is sitting second to the left of N. 

3. Q is the immediate neighbour of M and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05cbe2c458d5af68c6d38bc2617c0fa1513e35dd4551fbc01da4af89a673dae9.png] 

4. O is the immediate neighbour of R and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6597743390190087c8f4567dd8b17008b5a651bf0e814fe62069ab1ec1633b8a.png] 

P, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50d4ecf75b994d1bc7a3b4eb269ce9256f30c54da6bb2c18aa6be2d25c8adbe9.png] 

Clearly, P is sitting between M and N when considered from the right of N.

Hence, '**P**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word).

Bouquet : Flower :: Chain : __________
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Bouquet : Flower → A **bouquet** is a collection of **flowers** in a creative arrangement.

Similarly,

 
• Chain : __________ → **Chain** is a connected flexible series of metal **links** used for fastening or securing objects and pulling or supporting loads.

Hence, '**Link**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face having '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d712a8f0d8433df3a364ce32deca7b050889b23a57419bb6571a60fe774f4c3.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccb81837d115f44dadf9ec2c99ff329631adef591c7f48d4cbf238eb9036ea47.png] 

As 5 and 3 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 6 and 4 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bf8715bfc7a8c9037ac143ca212e9fc5f030e0529c2997629d629c4b79a9cbd.png] 

As 3 and 6 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 5 and 2 are opposite to each other.

As, 5 is opposite to 2, 6 is opposite to 4.

So, the remaining number '3' will be the number on the face opposite the face having '1'.

Hence, '**3**' is the correct answer.
